candidate.claim: fromJSON cannot rehydrate Document nodes: it handles root/decl/rule/comment/atrule but throws for type document even though Document with type document exists.
candidate.title: fromJSON throws for Document type

verifier.reason: fromJSON.js:38-50 branches only on root/decl/rule/comment/atrule and throws 'Unknown node type' in the else branch, while postcss.js:8 and postcss.js:82-88 require, export, and instantiate a Document class, so a type 'document' payload hits the throw.

candidate.claim: Long-line truncation computes subLineEnd with this.endColumn + padding without guarding undefined, producing NaN and an empty snippet when error has no range.
candidate.title: showSourceCode NaN when endColumn undefined

verifier.reason: Confirmed: css-syntax-error.js:22-25 sets only line/column for numeric arguments leaving endColumn undefined, and css-syntax-error.js:82-86 computes Math.max(this.column+padding, this.endColumn+padding) unguarded, so undefined+padding yields NaN, Math.max yields NaN, and line.slice(subLineStart, NaN) yields an empty truncated line.

candidate.claim: NoWorkResult.toString returns raw _css while css getter returns result.css which was stripped/updated via MapGenerator, so string coercion diverges from css.
candidate.title: NoWorkResult toString bypasses processed css

verifier.reason: Confirmed: NoWorkResult.css returns this.result.css at no-work-result.js:14, which is overwritten from MapGenerator output at no-work-result.js:80 and no-work-result.js:89, while toString() returns the unmodified this._css at no-work-result.js:127.
